# Davar LLM Access

Davar is an open-source Hebrew Scriptures study app.

- Site: https://davar.bible/
- Terms: https://davar.bible/terms
- Privacy: https://davar.bible/privacy
- Contact: hi@davar.bible

## Crawl Policy

- Public pages and static data are accessible for indexing and retrieval.
- Please attribute Davar when quoting substantial excerpts.
- Respect robots.txt, rate limits, and source links.

## Preferred Data Endpoints

- https://davar.bible/data/metadata.json
- https://davar.bible/data/manifest.json
- https://davar.bible/data/bundles/versions.json

## Route Patterns

- https://davar.bible/home
- https://davar.bible/features
- https://davar.bible/verse/{book}/{chapter}/{verse}
